answer_1.quote: Encoder-Decoder architecture has been widely used in natural language generation, especially neural machine translation (NMT).

answer_2.quote: Using multi-bleu.perl, we measure case-insensitive BLEU scores and case-sensitive ones for NIST Zh→En and WMT'14 En→De, respectively. For WMT'18 Zh→En, we use the case-sensitive BLEU scores calculated by mteval-v13a.pl.
